QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: videoSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Source for video stream (UDP, TCP, RTSP, or connected USB camera).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Source for video. UDP, TCP, RTSP and UVC Cameras may be supported depending on Vehicle and ground station version.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: udpUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network address and port for UDP video stream (e.g. 0.0.0.0:5600).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: 0.0.0.0:5600
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtspUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network address for RTSP video stream (e.g. rtsp://192.168.42.1:554/live).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: RTSP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: rtsp://192.168.42.1:554/live
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: RTSP URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tcpUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network address and port for TCP video stream (e.g. 192.168.143.200:3001).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP url address and port to bind to for video stream. Example: 192.168.143.200:3001
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: TCP URL

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: aspectRatio
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Video frame aspect ratio as width divided by height. Use 0 to auto-detect.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Video Aspect Ratio (width / height). Use 0.0 to ignore it.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Aspect Ratio

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gridLines
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Video Grid Lines
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Displays a grid overlaid over the video view.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video Grid Lines

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showTelemetryOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Shows the telemetry bar's values along the bottom of the video.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Shows the values the telemetry bar shows along the bottom of the video stream or USB camera, updated twice a second. Recordings don't include it: their telemetry goes to subtitle files.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Telemetry Overlay

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: videoFit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Video Display Fit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Handle Video Aspect Ratio.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video Display Fit

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showRecControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show Video Record Control
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show recording control in the UI.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show Video Record Control

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: recordingFormat
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: File format for saved video recordings.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Video recording file format.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Record File Format

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxVideoSize
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum disk space available for video recording storage.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Maximum amount of disk space used by video recording.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Max Storage Usage

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enableStorageLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Automatically delete oldest recordings when the storage limit is exceeded.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, old video files will be auto-deleted when the total size of QGC-recorded video exceeds the maximum video storage usage.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Auto-Delete Saved Recordings

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtspTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: RTSP Video Timeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How long to wait before assuming RTSP link is gone.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: RTSP Video Timeout

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: streamEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Video Stream Enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Start/Stop Video Stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video Stream Enabled

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: disableWhenDisarmed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Disables the video stream when the vehicle is disarmed to save bandwidth.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Disables the video stream when the vehicle is disarmed. Any active recording is also stopped.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Disable Video Stream When Disarmed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: lowLatencyMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimize video latency by disabling RTP playout buffering and retransmission recovery.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Sets RTP playout latency to zero and disables retransmission recovery. This reduces delay but may increase dropped or corrupted frames on lossy or reordered networks.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Low Latency Mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtpJitterLatencyMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: RTP jitter-buffer playout latency (ms).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Latency budget for the RTP jitter buffer (rtspsrc.latency / rtpjitterbuffer.latency). Lower = less glass-to-glass delay; higher = more headroom for packet reordering and retransmission. The default of 80 ms allows RFC 4588 retransmission to recover lost packets before the playout deadline; values <40 ms effectively disable retransmission. Ignored when Low Latency Mode is enabled.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: RTP jitter latency

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtspAutoReconnect
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Automatically restart the pipeline on watchdog timeout or pipeline error.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When enabled, the receiver reconnects with exponential backoff (1s → 30s) after a stream timeout or a fatal pipeline error. Disable to fall back to the legacy behaviour of giving up after one failure.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Auto-reconnect on stream loss

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: videoBackend
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Plays network video streams with GStreamer, or with Qt Multimedia's player.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: GStreamer plays every stream source and records them. Qt Multimedia plays them with FFmpeg: RTSP, MPEG-TS over UDP or TCP, and H.264 or H.265 RTP over UDP with payload type 96. It records a stream by encoding the video on display anew, and the decoder, CPU video path and RTP jitter latency settings don't apply to it. Changing it restarts the video stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video backend

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forceVideoDecoder
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Override automatic video decoder selection to force a specific decoding method.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Force the change of prioritization between video decode methods, allowing the user to force some video hardware decode plugins if necessary. Changing it restarts the video stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Default,Force software decoder,Force hardware decoder,Force NVIDIA decoder,Force VA-API decoder,Force Direct3D decoder,Force VideoToolbox decoder,Force Intel decoder,Force Vulkan decoder
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Force video decoder priority

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forceCpuVideoPath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Force the video pipeline to copy frames through CPU instead of importing GPU memory directly.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: By default, when a hardware decoder produces GPU-backed frames (DMABuf, GLMemory, D3D11, IOSurface, AHardwareBuffer), the pipeline imports them directly into Qt's render thread to avoid a per-frame CPU copy. The pipeline already falls back to the CPU path automatically when a GPU import fails, so this option is only needed for debugging or to work around a broken driver. Changing it restarts the video stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Force CPU video path

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: videoConversionElement
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Override the GStreamer conversion element at the head of the video sink.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Leave blank to auto-probe (SoC-native imxvideoconvert_g2d / nvvidconv when present, otherwise videoconvertscale). Set to a specific GStreamer factory name to force that element. Used as a workaround when an SoC's preferred element has a defect; changing it restarts the video stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Video conversion element override

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: disablePixelAspectRatio
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Let the video sink take non-square pixels instead of scaling them to square ones.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: QGC normally has the video sink ask for pixel-aspect-ratio=1/1, so non-square-pixel sources (some RTSP cams, DVB) are scaled instead of rendering geometrically distorted. A few v4l2 drivers without VIDIOC_CROPCAP deadlock negotiation when PAR is forced; enable this option as a workaround. Changing it restarts the video stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Disable pixel-aspect-ratio normalization

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcCameraFormat
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Resolution, frame rate and pixel format the USB camera runs in.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: One of the formats the USB camera offers, such as "1920x1080 30 fps MJPEG". Empty (Auto), or a format the camera doesn't offer, lets Qt choose: the highest resolution at 30 fps or more. MJPEG formats cost CPU time to decode; YUYV and NV12 formats don't, but need more USB bandwidth.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Format

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcCameraRotation
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Rotates the USB camera's picture clockwise, for a camera mounted on its side or upside down.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Rotates the USB camera's picture clockwise on screen and in screenshots, for a camera mounted on its side or upside down. Recordings keep the camera's own orientation.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Rotation

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcCameraMirror
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Mirrors the USB camera's picture left to right, after any rotation.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Mirrors the USB camera's picture left to right, after any rotation, on screen and in screenshots, for a camera that looks at the operator or through a mirror. Recordings keep the camera's own picture.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Mirror USB Camera

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcWhiteBalance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: White balance the USB camera uses: automatic, or set for the light.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: White balance the USB camera uses: automatic, or set for the light, such as Sunlight (5600 K) or Cloudy (6000 K). Shown for a camera that can set it; one the camera lacks leaves its white balance as it is.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera White Balance

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcZoom
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Zoom of the USB camera, from 1x up to the most the camera offers.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Zoom of the USB camera, from 1x up to the most the camera offers. Shown for a camera that zooms. On Linux Qt scales a camera's zoom range to 1x to 2x.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Zoom

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcExposureCompensation
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Brightens (positive) or darkens (negative) the USB camera's automatic exposure, in EV.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Brightens (positive) or darkens (negative) the USB camera's automatic exposure, in EV. Shown for a camera that can set it, except on Linux, where Qt can't.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Exposure Compensation

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcFocusMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How the USB camera focuses: automatically, or fixed far away.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How the USB camera focuses: automatically, preferring near or far subjects, or fixed at the hyperfocal distance or at infinity, as for a camera looking at the ground from the air. Shown for a camera that can set it, except on Linux, where Qt can't.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Focus

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: uvcRecordingCodec
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Video codec a USB camera recording tries first.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: One of the codecs Qt can encode on this computer, by its QMediaFormat::VideoCodec key, such as "H264". Empty (Auto), or a codec the encoder turns down, records with the first of H.264, H.265, AV1, VP9, MPEG-4 Part 2 and MPEG-2 that encodes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: USB Camera Recording Codec
